title: Multiple tags per hour
description: Owner request (2026-08-12, during the live review session): let the user tick more than one category chip when calling an hour — e.g. an hour that was genuinely Comms + Admin. Today the whole stack assumes exactly one tag per entry: the DB column is entries.tag (single text, lib/db/schema.ts), the engine's buildEntry resolves ONE tag via payload.tag || inferTag(bullets) || 'Unfiled' (lib/timer/engine.ts), validation has a single-value tagSchema (lib/validation/), the API payloads carry draftTag: string|null (lib/api/timer-state.ts StatePayload, lib/client/useTimer.ts ClientState), PickerStrip renders single-select chips with aria-pressed, DayView shows one tag chip + one entry bar color, and GridView colors each hour cell with tagColor(entry.tag) — one color per cell by design. Making tags plural therefore needs: a schema migration (tag -> tags array or a join table), engine + validation + API shape changes, multi-select chip UI, and DESIGN DECISIONS the owner should be asked at conversion time: how does a grid cell color an hour with 2+ tags (split? dominant-first? striped?), does tag inference still fire and does it append or only fill-when-empty, is there a cap on tags per entry (storage caps live in lib/validation LIMITS), and what do the vine chips/day strip show. Also note the related-but-separate captured idea about squashing entries — both touch the entry model, so converting them in the same sweep may share a migration.

title: Squash entries into the hour + timestamped bullets
description: Owner request (2026-08-12, during the live review session): a way to merge an entry with the entry below it — the owner phrased it as possibly a 'Squash to the hour' button — for cases where messing around / short accidental entries left several fragments that should really be one hour block (their vine that night had 12:05-12:08 Asleep, 12:09-12:09 Unfiled, 12:11-12:17 Comms fragments from testing). Coupled second half of the same request: when bullets are jotted, record the TIME each bullet was added, so that when entries are squashed by the hour the bullets can be placed into the right hour block. Today bullets are a plain string[] on entries.bullets and on the draft (draftBullets through engine/API/client), with no per-bullet metadata — timestamping bullets changes the bullet representation everywhere (schema JSONB shape, engine draftUpdate, validation bulletsSchema + caps, BulletJotter editing including Enter-splits and Backspace-merges, EntryEditor, DayView rendering, export endpoint). Squashing needs: a merge operation (probably an API endpoint on entries), UI affordance in the day view (per-entry action or drag?), rules for merging tags/feels/intents of the merged entries (relates to the separately captured multiple-tags-per-hour idea — a squashed hour with two different tags is exactly the multi-tag case), and what happens to the time range (owner said squash 'to the hour'). No decisions made — capture only; the owner explicitly deferred this during a UI review batch.
